title: Authentication evidence roadmap
description: Deliver the shared authentication core and its DNS, header, RUA, readiness, automation, and graph consumers in the fixed phased order.
close_reason: Completed all seven authentication-evidence phases and release gates.

title: Phase 0: Establish core boundaries and regression baseline
description: Inventory the resolver, diagnostics, UI wiring, exports, schemas, tests, and workflows. Extract UI-independent decision logic and define versioned core contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The Web UI uses the shared core with equivalent results and the regression suite passes.
close_reason: Shared core and regression baseline completed.

title: Phase 1: Implement RFC 9989 DMARC discovery core
description: Implement RFC 9989 Organizational Domain discovery, DNS Tree Walk, inheritance, record classification, and policy provenance with mocked DNS fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery returns requested and effective policy, source domain, discovery path, and classification; RFC 9989 boundary fixtures pass.
close_reason: RFC 9989 discovery, invalid-policy handling, bounded Tree Walk, and provenance completed.

title: Phase 2: Build header and EML analyzer
description: Add browser-local pasted-header and EML analysis with bounded parsing, normalized evidence, alignment evaluation, and reported-versus-verified labels.
acceptance_criteria: A user can trace reported DMARC evidence without mistaking it for independent DKIM verification.
close_reason: Browser-local header and EML analyzer with JSON export completed.

title: Phase 3: Build browser-local RUA analyzer
description: Safely parse XML, gzip, ZIP, and multiple RUA inputs into a canonical report model and aggregate alignment evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A report upload identifies failing senders and causes with parser, archive, identity, and domain-correlation limits enforced locally.
close_reason: Bounded RUA parsing, de-duplication, domain binding, aggregation, export, tests, and browser flow completed.

title: Phase 4: Add policy impact and readiness decisions
description: Create evidence-backed readiness decisions with reasons, blockers, warnings, source evidence, and effective-policy consistency.
acceptance_criteria: The product gives an evidence-backed reject-policy recommendation with explicit blockers and warnings.
close_reason: Effective-policy-aware readiness with RUA evidence gates and domain binding completed.

title: Phase 5: Deliver CLI and GitHub Action
description: Expose shared contracts through check, header, rua, readiness, snapshot, and diff commands with CI regression detection and stable findings.
acceptance_criteria: Checks, evidence analysis, snapshots, schema validation, and regressions run through CLI and CI without the Web UI.
close_reason: Bounded CLI, Draft 2020-12 contracts, complete findings, and threshold-safe Action output completed.

title: Phase 6: Visualize SPF and DKIM supply chain
description: Graph SPF dependency paths and DKIM selectors and observations while preserving declared, observed, unresolved, and inferred states.
acceptance_criteria: Users can compare DNS-authorized senders against observed senders through bounded accessible graph and table views.
close_reason: Bounded graph, merged domain identities, direct portable imports, localization, PWA registration, and accessibility completed.
